title: Classic Bordeaux: A Walking Tour Through France’s Most Elegant City
description: A walk from the Miroir d’eau and Place de la Bourse through Place du Parlement and the Golden Triangle shopping streets to the Grand Théâtre and Porte Dijeaux.
creator: Ira Szmuk

title: The Best of Bordeaux: A Sightseeing Walk
description: A walk from the Monument aux Girondins past the Grand Théâtre, the cathedral and Pey Berland tower, and the Porte Cailhau to Place de la Bourse and the Miroir d’eau.
creator: Lily Begg and Miguel Angel Moreno

title: Discover Bordeaux on a walk from the Cathedral to the Garonne River
description: A walk from the cathedral on Place Pey Berland through Porte Dijeaux, Place Gambetta, and the Golden Triangle to Rue Sainte-Catherine and the river.
creator: Inigo Gonzalez

title: Bordeaux by a Local: A Walk through the Centuries
description: A local guide’s walk from the Grand Théâtre through medieval streets, hidden arcades, and the cathedral to the Grosse Cloche bell tower and Place de la Bourse.
creator: Bordeaux with Marina Cauchie

title: Bordeaux’s Wine Quarter: A Chartrons Walking Tour
description: A walk along the river into the Chartrons, the old wine merchants’ quarter, past its market hall and wine museum to a view of the Cité du Vin.
creator: Bordeaux with Marina Cauchie
